composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the diorama centered and filling about 75% of the frame with even margins (at least 12% on every side). It is a small compact diorama group — a blackboard standing behind a couple of desks — not a room interior: no side walls, no ceiling, no floor plane. The blackboard surface is COMPLETELY BLANK: one flat dark green board, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no chalk marks, no smudges that could read as text. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the diorama floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadows only within the objects. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: writing, chalk marks or smudges on the blackboard
attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
side walls, ceiling, windows or a room interior
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the diorama
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the diorama.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の「教室」の場面カット。作った給食が誰のところへ届くのかを一目で伝える小さなジオラマ
scene: a miniature classroom diorama with no people in it: one small blackboard with a warm wooden frame and a completely blank flat dark green surface standing at the back, two small wooden school desks in front of it with a pale cream lunch tray set on each desk, and one small wooden chair beside them. Same matte clay / miniature toy material, same lighting and same warm palette as the school building and the cream lunch tray. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
required_objects: one blackboard with a completely blank surface and no writing
two small desks with a lunch tray on each
